svg.title: Red Yellow Blue White and Black with White Border
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry, interpretive colours. Seven observed panels in order blue, red, white, black, yellow, white, blue. White painted borders retained; neutral seam guides are diagrammatic. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of red, yellow, black, blue, white; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.sfmoma.org/artwork/99.349/; reviewed 2026-10-27; not a facsimile.
